fix_summary: §0/§7.1: 'k/N × dense' compute claim corrected to 'k × single expert-FFN, independent of N'.
§0/§2.1 table: Qwen3-MoE split out as top-8/128 (no shared); DeepSeek-V2 corrected to 6 routed+2 shared (was miswritten as +1); DeepSeek-V3 kept at 8 routed+1 shared.
§0/§6.2: 'V3 drops aux loss' softened to 'bias is primary, tiny sequence-wise aux loss remains as backstop'.
§2.2: Σf_i·P_i 'uniform = global minimum' claim corrected — uniform is only a self-consistent fixed point (counterexample N=2 added); Q3 answer aligned.
§2.3: Expert Choice 'no token dropping' corrected to 'no expert overflow' + token-side 0-hit caveat.

§2.4/§3.1/§6.1: DeepSeek-V3 biased-score formula corrected — bias added AFTER sigmoid (s_i=σ(u_t·e_i) is already the affinity), not to raw pre-sigmoid logits; gating renormalizes the un-biased affinity directly; added missing routed_scaling_factor≈2.5 note in formula, code comments, and the §6.1 diagram.
§2.5 (NEEDS_NUANCE): noisy top-k's purpose reframed as exploration + differentiable load-estimate proxy, not 'softening TopK itself to be differentiable'.
§4.2: 'Token Drop vs Residual Bypass' reframed as the same mechanism under standard residual connections; added note that Mixtral/DeepSeek-V3 are dropless in practice; Q4 answer aligned.
§4.3: Z-loss mislabeled as 'entropy regularizer' corrected to the log-partition stabilization term; 'enlarge capacity factor to punish collapse' removed as a false fix.
§4.4: gradient-w.r.t.-excluded-logit claim corrected from 'indirectly nonzero' to exactly zero, with full derivation; aligned with §10 Q12.
§6.3: Node-Limited Routing's fabricated 'each node capped at 3 experts' constraint removed, replaced with the actual node-scoring + top-4-node + global-top-8 mechanism.
§7.3: 'V3 KV cache ~5% of LLaMA-3-70B' corrected to ~21% (LLaMA-3-70B already uses GQA; 93.3% is a different MLA-vs-MHA baseline).
§9.1/Q10: same-active-params 'bandwidth advantage' inverted claim corrected to same-total-params comparison; capacity-ceiling table row fixed.
Q18: '8×H100 minimum for V3' corrected — 640GB < 671GB required; needs 9+ cards, in practice 16×H100 or 8×H200.
Q20: Mixtral 8x7B parameter breakdown replaced with an exact derivation giving 46.70B total / 12.87B active.
Appendix: Switch Transformers citation year corrected from '(2021) JMLR' to '(2022) JMLR, arXiv preprint 2021'.
